summary: Implemented seeded finite-shot Pauli measurement of Hubbard energy, total double occupancy and kinetic energy, with five grouped settings, raw outcome counts, marginal 95% Hoeffding confidence intervals and exact prepared-state/ground-state references. The studio compares three shot budgets across seven interactions. At 4096 shots per setting, endpoint double occupancies are 0.499756 and 0.052490 with CI half-width 0.021220, while high-U energy certification remains conservative. Legacy APIs and cases are retained; no hardware or materials-performance claim.
